title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the relationship 9f_1 = f_2.

title: Image Characteristics
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe the conditions for forming an inverted, virtual image at the same size as the object.

title: Lens Arrangement
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the arrangement of the two lenses and their respective object and image distances.

title: Use of Lens Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the Gaussian lens formula correctly to derive the necessary relationships.

title: Sketch Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear sketch illustrating the image formation process.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in image distance calculations.

title: Focal Lengths
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the significance of the focal lengths in determining the lens configuration.

title: Object Placement
description: Important Criteria: The student must specify the correct placement of the object relative to the lenses.
